acceptanceCriteria.text: Mobile game container has paddingBottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)
No game buttons are hidden under the iOS home indicator
Verified on iPhone and iPad Safari

snapshot.description: On iOS (browser and PWA), the home indicator (navigation pill) at the bottom of the screen covers the game's bottom action buttons (e.g. Cancel / Next in wizard flows). Fix applied: added paddingBottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom) to the mobile game container div so the iframe never extends under the safe area. Also removed redundant height:100dvh from the iframe (flex:1 is sufficient).
snapshot.title: iOS safe-area: bottom navigation pill overlaps game buttons
